name: Aditya Vaishya
bio: Professor Aditya Vaishya is an Associate Professor at the Division of Mathematical and Physical Sciences, School of Arts and Sciences, Ahmedabad University. He is an Atmospheric Physicist specialising in physicochemical characterisation of atmospheric aerosols in diverse environments, aerosol - radiation interaction under sub-saturated and super-saturate humidity fields, and aerosol instrumentation, and whose research interests include aerosol-cloud-radiation interaction, development of light-weight sensors for atmospheric studies, and air quality modelling.
